# Getly

> The Super App For Modern Traveller — one hidden global wallet, virtual
> cards, eSIM, flight bookings, hotel stays, travel protection, and visa processing
> in a single app for travellers, immigrants, and professionals.

## Product
- [Wallet](https://getly.app/wallet): One wallet, every currency you touch.
- [Cards](https://getly.app/cards): A virtual card for every purchase.
- [eSIM](https://getly.app/esim): Global data plans, no physical SIM.
- [Flights & Bookings](https://getly.app/flights): Book flights without leaving your wallet.
- [Hotel Stays](https://getly.app/hotels): Book boutique stays worldwide.
- [Travel Protection](https://getly.app/insurance): Comprehensive global travel and health coverage.
- [Visa Processing](https://getly.app/visa): Digital visa assistance and entry requirement checks.
- [AI Trip Planner](https://getly.app/ai-trip-planner): Personalised itineraries and budget planning.
